title: Radiomic ImmunoScore from CT estimates tumor microenvironment in gastric cancer
summary: An SVM learned an immune score from CT radiomics (Radiomic ImmunoScore); it gave AUC 0.85 for the immune score in the TCGA cohort and AUC 0.72 for prognosis with HR 2.72 in the independent Nanfang cohort. A nomogram built on it outperformed TNM staging. The study is retrospective with moderate validation AUC.
ai_technology: Support vector machine on CT radiomic features

evidence.unknown: Prospective validation and adjuvant chemotherapy benefit.
evidence.ai_role: Estimates the immune score from imaging
